Class NeoFlix

    • addEpisode

      public void addEpisode(String title, String series, String attempts, String completed, String votes, String sumVotes) throws NeoFlixException
      Adds a new episode to the catalog after validating business preconditions.
      Parameters:
      title - the title of the episode
      series - the title of the series to which the episode belongs
      attempts - the number of viewing attempts
      completed - the number of completed viewings
      votes - the total number of votes received
      sumVotes - the total sum of all vote scores
      Throws:
      NeoFlixException - CONTENT_EMPTY if the title is empty, REPEATED_NAME if a content with the same title already exists, NOT_A_NUMBER if any metric is not a valid integer, OUT_OF_RANGE if the metrics violate domain invariants, NOT_A_SERIES if the referenced content is not a series

    • addSeries

      public void addSeries(String title, String year, String theEpisodes) throws NeoFlixException
      Adds a new series to the catalog along with its associated episodes.
      Parameters:
      title - the title of the series
      year - the release year of the series
      theEpisodes - the titles of the episodes separated by newlines
      Throws:
      NeoFlixException - CONTENT_EMPTY if the title or episodes list is empty, REPEATED_NAME if a content with the same title already exists, NOT_A_NUMBER if the year is not a valid integer, WRONG_YEAR if the year is prior to 1888, EPISODE_NOT_FOUND if any specified episode does not exist
